notes: Skeletons now carry hands and feet. The pose reader has always seen the whole body, a hundred and thirty-three points, and the app kept eighteen; a wrist and an ankle say where a hand or foot is but nothing about which way it points or what the fingers do, which is where the GPU was left guessing. Extract now keeps the six foot points, big toe, small toe and heel each side, and both twenty-one-point hands, dropping a hand the reader was unsure of rather than drawing a wrong one. The skeleton draws them the way OpenPose does: each finger as a chain of edges stepping round the colour wheel with blue dots on the joints, and each foot as an extension of the leg in the ankle's own colour. In the editor there is a switch per hand and per foot, so one the reader misread can be turned off and left to the prompt, and a hand or foot follows its wrist or ankle when that joint is dragged; Mirror swaps them with the body and Reset restores them. Poses read before this update have no hands or feet yet; Remove and Add them again to pick them up.
